f.title: Define day zero as RFV awareness of a case with the mandatory minimum information
f.statement: Day zero is the date on which the pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV), or whoever acts as such, becomes aware of a suspected adverse drug reaction (SRAM) with the minimum information, i.e. the mandatory fields of the notification form authorised by the ANM.
f.clause: III. Glosario de términos: Día cero

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Es la fecha en la que el RFV o quien haga sus veces tome conocimiento de una SRAM
 con la información mínima (campos obligatorios del formato de notificación autorizado
 por la ANM).
rows.location: III. Glosario de términos: Día cero
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets the reporting clock; guidance document so Recommended.
rows.quote_en: It is the date on which the RFV or whoever acts as such becomes aware of an SRAM with the minimum information (mandatory fields of the notification form authorised by the ANM).

f.title: Ensure security, confidentiality and integrity of PV data during processing and transfer
f.statement: Throughout the collection of pharmacovigilance data, the precautions needed to guarantee data security, confidentiality and unalterability during processing and transfer of information must be taken; the identity of the patient and of reporting professionals is kept confidential.
f.clause: III. Glosario de términos: Confidencialidad

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
En todo el proceso de
 recopilación de datos de farmacovigilancia deben tomarse las precauciones precisas
 para garantizar la seguridad de los datos y su confidencialidad e inalterabilidad
 durante los procesos de tratamiento y transferencia de la información.
rows.location: III. Glosario de términos: Confidencialidad
rows.review_note: Review: normative sentence inside the glossary; deben = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Throughout the process of collecting pharmacovigilance data, the precise precautions must be taken to guarantee the security of the data and their confidentiality and unalterability during the processing and transfer of the information.

f.title: Treat as serious any reaction meeting the listed seriousness criteria
f.statement: A serious adverse reaction is any medical occurrence with any dose of a pharmaceutical product that endangers life or causes death, requires or prolongs hospitalisation, causes permanent or significant disability or incapacity, causes alterations or malformations in the newborn, or contributes directly or indirectly to the patient's death.
f.clause: III. Glosario de términos: Reacción adversa grave

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Cualquier ocurrencia médica que se presente con la administración de cualquier dosis
de un producto farmacéutico, que ocasione uno o más de los siguientes supuestos:
rows.location: III. Glosario de términos: Reacción adversa grave
rows.review_note: Review: definition sets the 24-hour vs 20-day track; criteria a)-e) are in the following lines. Guidance = Recommended.
rows.quote_en: Any medical occurrence that arises with the administration of any dose of a pharmaceutical product, that causes one or more of the following:

f.title: Report suspected adverse reactions, not adverse events without suspected causality
f.statement: Only suspected adverse drug reactions (SRAM) must be notified, not adverse events (temporal coincidence without suspected causal relationship), as described in the glossary.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 1

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Solo se debe notificar las SRAM, no los eventos adversos, tal como se describe
     en el glosario de términos.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 1
rows.review_note: Review: guidance document, but level follows the modal "se debe" = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Only SRAM must be notified, not adverse events, as described in the glossary of terms.

f.title: Report suspected reactions for all pharmaceutical product classes, naming any co-packed solvent or device
f.statement: SRAM involving all pharmaceutical products must be notified: medicines (proprietary products, diagnostic agents, radiopharmaceuticals, medical gases), herbal medicines, dietary products and sweeteners, biological products (including those registered via similarity: immunologicals, blood/plasma derivatives, biotechnology products) and galenic products. If the product is registered with a solvent or medical device that causes the SRAM, the report is made on the pharmaceutical product, also specifying the solvent or device involved in administration.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 2

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Si el producto farmacéutico está registrado acompañado de un solvente o
     dispositivo médico; y este es causante de una SRAM, deberá notificarse al
     producto farmacéutico especificando también al solvente o dispositivo, que
     intervienen en su administración.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 2
rows.review_note: Review: product-class list summarised from item 2; quote covers the solvent/device rule.
rows.quote_en: If the pharmaceutical product is registered together with a solvent or medical device, and this causes an SRAM, it shall be notified against the pharmaceutical product, also specifying the solvent or device involved in its administration.

f.title: Report AEFIs (ESAVI) occurring with vaccines in Peru
f.statement: Events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation (ESAVI) occurring with the use of vaccines in the country must be notified.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 3

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Se debe notificar los ESAVI que se presenten con el uso de las vacunas en el
     país.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 3
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: ESAVI occurring with the use of vaccines in the country must be notified.

f.title: Report even without a definitive diagnosis and send the diagnosis later as follow-up
f.statement: An SRAM or ESAVI must be notified even when the definitive diagnosis has not yet been established or the notifier has doubts; when the diagnosis is later established, it is recorded and sent as follow-up of the initial report.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 4

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Una SRAM o ESAVI se debe notificar aun cuando todavía no se haya establecido
   el diagnóstico definitivo o cuando el notificador tenga dudas. Cuando
   posteriormente se establezca el diagnóstico, este se registrará y enviará como
   seguimiento de sram y ESAVI reportada inicialmente.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 4
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: An SRAM or ESAVI must be notified even when the definitive diagnosis has not yet been established or when the notifier has doubts. When the diagnosis is subsequently established, it will be recorded and sent as follow-up of the initially reported SRAM and ESAVI.

f.title: Report known and unknown reactions of any severity, prioritising serious, unknown and new-product cases
f.statement: Every known/expected or unknown/unexpected, mild, moderate and serious SRAM or ESAVI that comes to the notifier's knowledge must be notified, giving priority to serious or unknown ones and to all SRAM related to medicines recently marketed in Peru.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 5

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Se debe notificar toda SRAM o ESAVI conocida o esperada, desconocida o
   inesperada, leve, moderada y grave de la que se tome conocimiento, dando
   prioridad a las graves o desconocidas y todas aquellas sram relacionadas a los
   medicamentos de reciente comercialización en el país.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 5
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Every known or expected, unknown or unexpected, mild, moderate and serious SRAM or ESAVI of which knowledge is obtained must be notified, giving priority to serious or unknown ones and all SRAM related to medicines recently marketed in the country.

f.title: Report reactions from misuse, abuse, dependence, medication errors, quality problems, overdose and off-label use
f.statement: Every SRAM related to misuse or occupational exposure, dependence, abuse, medication errors, quality problems and overdose situations, including those caused by use outside the authorised conditions (off-label), must be notified.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 6

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Se debe notificar toda SRAM relacionada con el mal uso o exposición ocupacional,
   dependencia, abuso, errores de medicación, problemas de calidad y en
   situaciones de sobredosis, incluyendo las causadas por el uso fuera de las
   condiciones autorizadas
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 6
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Every SRAM related to misuse or occupational exposure, dependence, abuse, medication errors, quality problems and overdose situations must be notified, including those caused by use outside the authorised conditions

f.title: Report reactions with use in pregnancy and breastfeeding
f.statement: Every SRAM or ESAVI occurring with the use of pharmaceutical products in pregnancy and breastfeeding must be notified.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 7

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Se debe notificar toda SRAM o ESAVI que se presente con el uso de productos
   farmacéuticos en el embarazo y lactancia.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 7
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Every SRAM or ESAVI occurring with the use of pharmaceutical products during pregnancy and breastfeeding must be notified.

f.title: Report therapeutic failure of contraceptives, vaccines, life-threatening-disease drugs and new resistance
f.statement: Therapeutic failures must be notified for hormonal contraceptives, vaccines, pharmaceutical products used in life-threatening diseases, and anti-infectives where the germ is shown to be resistant when it previously was not.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 8

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Se debe notificar los fallos terapéuticos de anticonceptivos hormonales, vacunas,
   productos farmacéuticos usados en enfermedades que amenazan la vida del
   paciente y antiinfecciosos en los que se demuestre que el germen es resistente
   cuando previamente no lo era.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 8
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Therapeutic failures of hormonal contraceptives, vaccines, pharmaceutical products used in diseases that threaten the patient's life and anti-infectives in which the germ is shown to be resistant when previously it was not must be notified.

f.title: Do not report disease-progression events unrelated to the product; include them in periodic safety reports
f.statement: Cases with adverse events due to disease progression and not related to the suspect product must not be reported as SRAM; they must be considered in the Periodic Safety Reports (IPS).
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 9

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
No se debe reportar los casos que presenten eventos adversos debidos a la
   progresión de la enfermedad y que no estén relacionados al producto
   farmacéutico sospechoso; estos reportes deben ser considerados en los Informes
   Periódicos de Seguridad (IPS).
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 9
rows.review_note: Review: faithful; applies in practice to holders (IPS).
rows.quote_en: Cases presenting adverse events due to disease progression and not related to the suspect pharmaceutical product must not be reported; these reports must be considered in the Periodic Safety Reports (IPS).

f.title: Do not report inappropriate clinical use as therapeutic failure
f.statement: Where the clinical evaluation of a disease was not adequate (e.g. an antibiotic inappropriate for the pathogen per antibiogram), the case must not be reported as therapeutic failure.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 10

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Si la evaluación clínica de una enfermedad no fue la adecuada, no debe reportarse
    como fallo terapéutico.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 10
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: If the clinical evaluation of a disease was not adequate, it must not be reported as therapeutic failure.

f.title: For fatal cases, report the cause leading to death; death alone is not a valid reaction term
f.statement: For an SRAM with fatal outcome, the cause that led to the outcome must be indicated; a notification reporting only death as the SRAM is not valid (only sudden death is accepted as an SRAM).
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 11
f.processes: ICSR quality control; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
En caso de una sram con desenlace mortal, indicar la causa que originó el
    desenlace. La notificación no será válida si se notifica solo el desenlace de la sram
    como muerte, solo muerte súbita será considerada como sram.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 11
rows.review_note: Review: validity condition (report invalid otherwise), so Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: In the case of an SRAM with fatal outcome, indicate the cause that gave rise to the outcome. The notification will not be valid if only the SRAM outcome is notified as death; only sudden death will be considered an SRAM.

f.title: Report clinically significant abnormal test results as reactions and grade seriousness
f.statement: Clinically significant abnormal findings in laboratory tests, ECGs, imaging and other diagnostic tests, not evident at the time of diagnosis of the exposed patient, must be reported as an SRAM and classified as serious if they qualify.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 12

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
se deben reportar como una sram y clasificar como
    grave, si califica como tal.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 12
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the operative clause of item 12; subject in statement from the same item.
rows.quote_en: must be reported as an SRAM and classified as serious, if it qualifies as such.

f.title: Follow up pregnancies exposed to the company's products, including paternal exposure, to end of pregnancy
f.statement: Holders (TRS, TCRS) and health professionals must follow up pregnancies in which the foetus may have been exposed to one of their pharmaceutical products through the mother, also considering possible transmission via semen from paternal exposure, to detect possible adverse events in the foetus or newborn; information must be gathered from exposure to the end of pregnancy. Only adverse events causally related to the product and compatible with the definition of serious adverse reaction must be notified.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 13
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.actor: Holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS) and health professionals
rows.quote:
Los TRS, TCRS y PS deben realizar un seguimiento de los embarazos en los que
    el feto pueda haber estado expuesto a uno de sus productos farmacéuticos a
    través de la madre
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? 13
rows.review_note: Review: rest of item 13 (paternal exposure, end of pregnancy, serious-only notification) spans a page break; statement summarises it.
rows.quote_en: TRS, TCRS and health professionals must follow up pregnancies in which the foetus may have been exposed to one of their pharmaceutical products through the mother

f.title: Report reactions to cannabis and derivatives under this guidance and the applicable cannabis rules
f.statement: SRAM occurring with the use of cannabis and its derivatives must be notified according to this guidance and the regulations in force for these products; SRAM with natural products for health use may be notified in the same way.
f.clause: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? Nota
f.applicability: Cannabis and derivatives; natural products for health use (permitted)

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Las SRAM que se presenten con el uso del cannabis y sus derivados deben ser
notificadas de acuerdo a los parámetros considerados en el presente documento de
orientación y según la normatividad vigente que regula a estos productos.
rows.location: IV. ¿Cómo identificar y notificar una SRAM o ESAVI? Nota
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: SRAM occurring with the use of cannabis and its derivatives must be notified according to the parameters considered in this guidance document and according to the regulations in force governing these products.

f.title: Report through the RFV registered in CENAFyT's registry
f.statement: Holders of sanitary registrations and of sanitary registration certificates of pharmaceutical products must notify SRAM/ESAVI through their pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV), or whoever acts as such, registered in the CENAFyT Registry database.
f.clause: ¿Quiénes deben notificar las SRAM o ESAVI? 3

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Los TRS y TCRS de productos farmacéuticos a través del RFV o quien haga a
    sus veces, que se encuentran registrados en la Base de Registro del Cenafyt.
rows.location: ¿Quiénes deben notificar las SRAM o ESAVI? 3
rows.review_note: Review: listed under "who must notify" (deben). Annex 3 adds that the RFV must be registered beforehand by official communication (separate row).
rows.quote_en: TRS and TCRS of pharmaceutical products, through the RFV or whoever acts as such, who are registered in the Cenafyt Registry Base.

f.title: Use the TRS/TCRS SRAM form for domestic non-vaccine reports, and the ESAVI form for vaccines
f.statement: Holders must use the ANM-approved SRAM notification form for TRS/TCRS to notify reactions to any pharmaceutical product except vaccines occurring in Peru, following Annex 3; vaccine events are notified on the ESAVI form (which laboratories also use), following Annex 2.
f.clause: ¿Qué formatos aprobados deben utilizar para notificar las SRAM o ESAVI? 3
f.systems: SRAM notification form for TRS/TCRS (RD 144-2016-DIGEMID); ESAVI notification form

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
el cual debe ser utilizado por los TRS y TCRS para notificar
     cualquier producto farmacéutico, excepto vacunas, ocurridos en el ámbito nacional,
     siguiendo el ejemplo descrito en el anexo 3.
rows.location: ¿Qué formatos aprobados deben utilizar para notificar las SRAM o ESAVI? 3
rows.review_note: Review: ESAVI form for laboratories from item 2 summarised in statement.
rows.quote_en: which must be used by TRS and TCRS to notify any pharmaceutical product, except vaccines, occurring in the national territory, following the example described in Annex 3.

f.title: Include the mandatory minimum information in every SRAM/ESAVI notification
f.statement: SRAM or ESAVI notifications must contain: (1) patient: name(s), initials or identification code, sex and age, age group or date of birth; (2) one or more SRAM/ESAVI with onset date for each; (3) one or more suspect products with brand and generic name, dose/frequency, route and start/end dates of administration, and for biological products also laboratory/manufacturer, sanitary registration number and batch number; (4) an identifiable reporter; for TRS/TCRS the person reporting is the primary source or initial reporter (health professional, user or other).
f.clause: ¿Qué información se debe registrar obligatoriamente en la notificación de SRAM o ESAVI?
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Notifiers, including holders of sanitary registrations (TRS/TCRS)
rows.quote:
Las notificaciones de SRAM o ESAVI, deben contar con la siguiente información
  obligatoria:
rows.location: ¿Qué información se debe registrar obligatoriamente en la notificación de SRAM o ESAVI?
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the lead-in; items 1-4 summarised in statement from the list that follows.
rows.quote_en: Notifications of SRAM or ESAVI must contain the following mandatory information:

f.title: Start the clock at day zero and collect as much information as possible
f.statement: For notification purposes day zero starts when the health professional or the RFV of the TRS/TCRS becomes aware of the case with the mandatory information above; the notifier is committed to collecting as much of the information requested in the form as possible.
f.clause: ¿Qué información se debe registrar obligatoriamente en la notificación de SRAM o ESAVI?

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Para efectos de notificación el día cero inicia cuando el profesional de la salud o RFV
  del TRS o TCRS, toma conocimiento del caso con la información obligatoria antes
  mencionada, el notificador tendrá el compromiso de recolectar la mayor cantidad de
  información solicitada en el formato de notificación.
rows.location: ¿Qué información se debe registrar obligatoriamente en la notificación de SRAM o ESAVI?
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: For notification purposes, day zero starts when the health professional or RFV of the TRS or TCRS becomes aware of the case with the aforementioned mandatory information; the notifier will be committed to collecting as much of the information requested in the notification form as possible.

f.title: Submit serious SRAM/ESAVI to CENAFyT within 24 hours of day zero
f.statement: After the RFV has completed at least the mandatory fields of the notification form, it must submit SRAM or ESAVI notifications to CENAFyT on paper (form via the in-person or virtual front desk, or the institutional e-mail address) or electronically (eReporting Industria); serious cases within twenty-four (24) hours following day zero. When sent by e-mail, the subject must read "FV SRAM/ESAVI GRAVE - TRS o TCRS".
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D. Titulares de Registro Sanitario y Titulares del Certificado de Registro Sanitario

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Graves: Dentro de las veinticuatro (24) horas siguientes al día cero. De
           enviarlo por correo electrónico institucional indicar en el asunto “FV
           SRAM/ESAVI GRAVE - TRS o TCRS”.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D. Titulares de Registro Sanitario y Titulares del Certificado de Registro Sanitario
rows.review_note: Review: e-mail address omitted (checker). Guidance restating NTS 123 k.1; lead-in "deberá remitir" = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Serious: within twenty-four (24) hours following day zero. If sent by the institutional e-mail, indicate in the subject "FV SRAM/ESAVI GRAVE - TRS o TCRS".

f.title: Submit non-serious SRAM/ESAVI via eReporting Industria within 20 calendar days with causality per pair
f.statement: Mild or moderate SRAM/ESAVI must be submitted within no more than twenty (20) calendar days counted from the day after day zero, only through eReporting Industria, reporting the causality category for each medicine/SRAM or ESAVI combination according to the relevant instructions.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.deadline: 20 calendar days from the day after day zero
rows.quote:
Leves o moderadas: En un plazo no mayor a veinte (20) días calendario
           contados desde el día siguiente al día cero (solo por eReporting
           Industria*), debiendo informar la categoría de causalidad por cada
           combinación medicamento/SRAM o ESAVI, de acuerdo al instructivo
           correspondiente*.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Mild or moderate: within a period of no more than twenty (20) calendar days counted from the day following day zero (only through eReporting Industria*), having to report the causality category for each medicine/SRAM or ESAVI combination, according to the corresponding instructions*.

deadline_rule.clock_start: contados desde el día siguiente al día cero
deadline_rule.applies_to: Mild or moderate SRAM/ESAVI reported by holders

f.title: Send causality assessment in follow-up if missing from the initial report
f.statement: If the causality assessment was not sent in the initial report, it must be submitted in follow-up notifications.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Si en el reporte inicial no se envió la evaluación de causalidad, se deberá remitir
    esta información en las notificaciones de seguimiento.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: If the causality assessment was not sent in the initial report, this information shall be submitted in the follow-up notifications.

f.title: If day zero falls on a weekend or holiday, send serious reports on the first business day
f.statement: When day zero is a public holiday or weekend day, the serious SRAM/ESAVI notification must be sent on the first business day.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
f.exceptions: Applies only when day zero is a holiday or weekend day

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.deadline: First business day when day zero is a weekend or holiday
rows.quote:
Cuando el día cero sea un día feriado o de fin de semana, deberá enviar la
    notificación de SRAM o ESAVI grave el primer día hábil.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: no fixed count, so no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: When day zero is a public holiday or a weekend day, the serious SRAM or ESAVI notification shall be sent on the first business day.

f.title: Re-submit e-mailed serious reports in eReporting Industria within 30 calendar days
f.statement: If the serious notification was sent to the institutional e-mail address, it must subsequently be submitted through eReporting Industria within 30 calendar days of knowledge of the case.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
f.applicability: Serious reports first sent by e-mail

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.deadline: 30 calendar days from knowledge of the case
rows.quote:
Si esta notificación la
    envió al correo electrónico institucional, posteriormente deberá enviarla por
    eReporting industria* dentro de los 30 días calendarios de conocido el caso.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: If this notification was sent to the institutional e-mail, it shall subsequently be sent through eReporting Industria* within 30 calendar days of knowledge of the case.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious SRAM/ESAVI first sent by e-mail

f.title: Submit the serious-case investigation report within 10 calendar days of a CENAFyT request
f.statement: When CENAFyT requests an investigation report on a serious SRAM, the holder may prepare it in its own establishment format provided it contains all the requested information, and must submit it through customer service or the virtual front desk within no more than ten (10) calendar days counted from the day after receipt of the ANM request; if the deadline falls on a weekend or holiday, it is submitted on the first business day via document processing.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
f.applicability: Serious SRAM when CENAFyT requests an investigation report

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.deadline: 10 calendar days from the day after receipt of the ANM request
rows.quote:
El informe lo remitirá
    a través del área de atención al cliente o mesa de partes virtual, en un plazo no
    mayor a diez (10) días calendario contados desde el día siguiente de la
    recepción de la solicitud enviada por la ANM.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: own format permitted ("puede") is in the statement; deadline is a duty (remitirá). Differs from NTS 123 k.1 (10 days from receipt of notification, automatic) - this guidance makes it on request.
rows.quote_en: It will submit the report through the customer service area or the virtual front desk within a period of no more than ten (10) calendar days counted from the day following receipt of the request sent by the ANM.

deadline_rule.clock_start:
contados desde el día siguiente de la
    recepción de la solicitud enviada por la ANM
deadline_rule.applies_to: Investigation reports on serious SRAM requested by CENAFyT

f.title: Send additional information promptly in follow-up or final notifications
f.statement: Where information additional to the initial report becomes available, it must be sent as soon as possible in follow-up or final notifications.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
En caso se disponga de información adicional al reporte inicial, ésta deberá ser
    enviada, a la brevedad posible, en las notificaciones de seguimiento o finales.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D.
rows.review_note: Review: no fixed time, so no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: Where information additional to the initial report is available, it shall be sent as soon as possible in follow-up or final notifications.

f.title: Holders without eReporting Industria access may use eReporting
f.statement: Holders that do not have access to eReporting Industria may submit their notifications through eReporting, following the corresponding instructions.
f.clause: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D. Nota

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Los TRS o TCRS que no cuenten con acceso a eReporting industria,
    podrán realizar sus notificaciones a través del eReporting, siguiendo el
    instructivo* correspondiente.
rows.location: Tiempos y medios para el envío de las notificaciones, D. Nota
rows.review_note: Review: podrán = Permitted.
rows.quote_en: TRS or TCRS that do not have access to eReporting Industria may submit their notifications through eReporting, following the corresponding instructions*.

f.title: Use one company case number for initial, follow-up and final reports
f.statement: The company notification number is a code assigned by the holder that must be used for the initial, follow-up and final notification of the SRAM.
f.clause: Anexo N° 3: Ejemplo para el llenado del formato de notificación de SRAM por los TRS y TCRS
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Nº notificación de la empresa. Código asignado por el TRS, el mismo que
   debe ser usado para la notificación inicial, de seguimiento y final de la SRAM.
rows.location: Anexo N° 3: Ejemplo para el llenado del formato de notificación de SRAM por los TRS y TCRS
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Company notification No.: code assigned by the TRS, which must be used for the initial, follow-up and final notification of the SRAM.

f.title: Send one notification per suspect medicine(s) and distinguish suspect from concomitant drugs
f.statement: Only one notification must be sent per suspect medicine(s); where the SRAM followed two or more drugs, if one is considered suspect the others are concomitant, but if the most likely cannot be identified, all are considered suspect. For fixed-dose combinations, give the brand name and describe the active substances.
f.clause: Anexo N° 3, Sección C
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Solo deberá enviar una notificación por medicamento(s) sospechoso(s). En caso
  que la SRAM se haya presentado después de administrado dos o más fármacos,
rows.location: Anexo N° 3, Sección C
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the start of the paragraph; rest summarised.
rows.quote_en: Only one notification shall be sent per suspect medicine(s). Where the SRAM occurred after administration of two or more drugs,

f.title: Report recovery as follow-up when a non-recovered reaction resolves
f.statement: If the SRAM is still present at the time of notification (not recovered), once the symptoms end it must be notified as follow-up, marking the appropriate outcome (recovered or recovered with sequelae).
f.clause: Anexo N° 3, Sección B (Desenlace)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Una
   vez que termine los síntomas se deberá notificar como seguimiento, marcando
   la opción adecuada (recuperado o recuperado con secuela).
rows.location: Anexo N° 3, Sección B (Desenlace)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: Once the symptoms end, it shall be notified as follow-up, marking the appropriate option (recovered or recovered with sequelae).

f.title: Register the in-country PV responsible person with CENAFyT before reporting
f.statement: The form must give the full name, e-mail and telephone of the company's pharmacovigilance responsible person in Peru, who must have been previously registered with CENAFyT through the corresponding official communication.
f.clause: Anexo N° 3, Sección E

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
del RFV en el Perú, quien debe estar previamente registrado en el Cenafyt,
mediante la comunicación oficial correspondiente.
rows.location: Anexo N° 3, Sección E
rows.review_note: Review: faithful.
rows.quote_en: of the RFV in Peru, who must be previously registered with the Cenafyt by means of the corresponding official communication.

f.title: Record reception date, notification date, report type and information source in holder reports
f.statement: Holder reports must record the date the TRS/RFV became aware of the case with the minimum mandatory fields, the date of notification to CENAFyT, the report type (initial, follow-up, final; both initial and final if closed at once) and the source (spontaneous; study, giving the PASS name or the ANM active-PV protocol code; literature for national or international literature cases that occurred in Peru; other, e.g. compassionate use or patient support programme), the causality category assessed by the RFV, and whether the reporter also reported to CENAFyT, to avoid duplicates.
f.clause: Anexo N° 3, Sección E
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (TRS/TCRS), through its pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Fecha de recepción por el TRS: Indicar día/mes/año que el TRS y/o RFV
   farmacovigilancia tenga conocimiento del caso con los campos mínimos
   obligatorios.
rows.location: Anexo N° 3, Sección E
rows.review_note: Review: form-completion instructions summarised; quote proves the receipt-date field. Recommended (filling instructions).
rows.quote_en: Date of receipt by the TRS: indicate day/month/year on which the TRS and/or pharmacovigilance RFV becomes aware of the case with the minimum mandatory fields.
